title: Resin Gun
description: A weapon to catch and transfer Mobs with fancy animations
body:
A new formula has been added to the original "Resin", and a new non-lethal long-range weapon "Resin Gun" has been introduced. Players can synthesize "Gel Bullets" by combining "Resin Balls" and "Glass Bottles". After filling the "Resin Gun" with "Gel Bullets", they can shoot the resin at the original creatures and seal the creatures in "Amber" after hitting them. The creatures wrapped in "Amber" can be simply excavated by the players and put into the backpack, or the "Amber" can be melted with a "Fire Stone" placed on the ground to rescue the trapped creatures. 

Note: The resin gun cannot capture [hot-blooded creatures], [slime], and [bosses], and it is ineffective in [the Underworld] and [water].

---

为原版【树脂】添加了新的配方和增加了新的非致命远程武器【树脂枪】，玩家可以使用【树脂团】和【玻璃瓶】合成出【凝胶弹】，将【凝胶弹】填装进【树脂枪】后可以朝着原版生物发射树脂，并在击中生物后将生物封入【琥珀】中。被【琥珀】包裹的生物可以被玩家简单地挖掘并装入背包，或使用【打火石】融化【放置在地面上的琥珀】将困在其中的生物解救出来。

注意：树脂枪无法捕捉【高温生物】和【史莱姆】以及【Boss】，并且在【下界】和【水中】无法生效
